scenes.vo: Stop doing this before bed if you want to be taller.
Don't panic, you can still unlock your full natural height.
Your spine decompresses and recovers overnight. Just build these three night habits.
Number one: screen off sixty minutes before bed for deep recovery.
Number two: get eight to ten hours of uninterrupted sleep.
Number three: do a gentle two-minute spine stretch right before sleep.
And there's way more inside our app. Get your personal routine in TallPlan.
